properties.description: Manual start uses exactly the selected pumps.

properties.formula: G((!stop & start & mode) -> (((runs[1] <-> TopThree1)) & ((runs[2] <-> TopThree2)) & ((runs[3] <-> TopThree3)) & ((runs[4] <-> TopThree4)) & ((runs[5] <-> TopThree5))))
properties.description: Automatic start runs exactly the highest-priority three.
The FB may not modify priorities or selections.

atomic_propositions.top3: Deprecated alias for automatic top-3 selection; active P3 uses expanded TopThree1..TopThree5.
atomic_propositions.runPrev[i]: The pre-scan RunComd value of pump i.
atomic_propositions.readOnlyPreserved: All five priority and selection values equal their sampled values.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or output.
atomic_propositions.TopThree1: (1-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree2: (2-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree3: (3-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree4: (4-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.TopThree5: (5-1) is in first three ordinal indices of sorted(range(5), key=lambda j: (-I[k].pumpGroup[j].priority,j)).
atomic_propositions.pumpGroup: O[k].pumpGroup: independently observed post-scan candidate value (ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump); never defined as expected output. I[k].pumpGroup denotes separately captured caller value before invocation.
